summary: Add real-server TLS interoperability coverage. The reported Apple pre-trust decode error was not reproduced on macOS 26.6.2. No production TLS, certificate, pinning or transport behavior changes.

desktop.reason: Only backend tests and instructions change; Electron product code is unchanged.

reactNativeIos.reason: macOS URLSession coverage does not change or build the iOS app or native module.

nativeAndroid.reason: No Android implementation changes; real-device Android verification remains pending.

sharedBackendApi.reason: Production server, wire contract, TLS settings and cleartext compatibility are unchanged.

storageDataMigration.reason: Stored keys, certificates and fingerprints are preserved with no migration or re-pair required.

updateRelease.reason: No packaging, signing, update-channel or deployment changes; coverage ships with the normal source tree.

automated: macOS-only vitest compiles tests/fixtures/apple-tls-probe.swift and checks matching pin opens and echoes, wrong pin reaches the trust callback and cancels, and forced TLS 1.2 works against DualWebSocketServer with a persisted production certificate.
Portable vitest coverage splits a ClientHello after the first byte for TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3.

Manual scratch probes: Node 25.9.0 and Electron Node 24.18.1; 32 fresh production certificates passed 64 Apple probes across default TLS and TLS 1.2. Curl with h2,http/1.1 ALPN and OpenSSL s_client TLS 1.2 completed handshakes.
notExercised: No iPhone, Android device, simulator, Expo bridge or Safari browser was exercised.
The original failing scratch certificate and probe were unavailable. No root cause or before-fix regression is claimed.
